stageA3_clockCorrection.problem: A2 used Date.now() as the budget clock. Date.now is wall-clock (non-monotonic): NTP/skew adjustments can move the wall clock forward or backward mid-loop, so elapsed-time accounting and the across-attempt baseline are not guaranteed monotonic. Root-directed correction: keep EVERYTHING else identical, time the budget on the true monotonic clock only.
stageA3_clockCorrection.fix: frontend/scripts/lighthouse-runtime-preflight.mjs now imports {performance} from node:perf_hooks (the same singleton as globalThis.performance) and times the CPU_BUDGET_MS with performance.now() at exactly the three sites A2 used (start baseline, pre-attempt >= 30000 throw, post-attempt > 30000 throw). MAX_CPU_ATTEMPTS=30, CPU_BUDGET_MS=30000, both pre+post checks, fail-closed messages, cpuReady, benchmark, launch settings, about:blank-only, finally page.close: ALL unchanged and byte-identical to the A2-approved version.
